backend.envVarValue: bare host only, e.g. http://172.16.0.12 (no path) — same physical host as the MODEL_STUDIO logical key, reused under a distinct BACKEND_ENV entry
backend.responseEnvelope: { success: boolean, message: string, data: object|array|null }
backend.authHeadersActuallySent: Authorization: Bearer <token> AND Cookie: access_token=<token> (see CLAUDE.md API rule 3) — injected globally by src/app/api/_lib/proxy.js, never per-route

plantField.name: plant_code_id
plantField.note: Sent per CLAUDE.md Rule 0: query param for this GET endpoint. Sourced from useApp().plantCode in useForecastPage.js, threaded down into getForecastOverview(plant_code) — never read from AppContext inside the service file.

notes: MODEL_STUDIO (the pre-existing logical backend key) has NO gateway prefix in BACKEND_PATHS — its many existing routes (src/app/api/modelfactory/**) call the bare host directly with the full path baked into each route's own `path:`. Adding a decisionops-pod2 prefix directly onto MODEL_STUDIO would have broken every one of those routes, so this refactor introduces a SEPARATE logical key (MODEL_FACTORY) that reuses the same SERVICE_MODEL_STUDIO_URL env var (confirmed identical host, 172.16.0.12) but carries its own gateway-prefixed BACKEND_PATHS entry — same pattern as PLANT_CODE_ID reusing DOMAIN_CONFIGURATION's env var under a distinct key.

Only the Forecast Studio Overview tab's endpoint was refactored onto this new gateway contract so far. The rest of the /p2/forecasting/* endpoints (model list, pipelines, experiments) are unchanged and still resolve through MODEL_STUDIO with no gateway prefix.

Response envelope changed shape: old contract was { statusCode: 200, data: [...] } (flat array of { name, counts, info }); new contract is { success, message, data: { kpis: [{ metric_name, value }] } }. useForecastPage.js's fetchOverviewData() and ForecastOverview.jsx were both updated to read/render the new kpis shape natively — no adapter kept.

proxyRoutes: src/app/api/modelfactory/[...path]/route.js (backend: MODEL_STUDIO, bare host — flagged unused/dead, no confirmed caller, left in place)
src/app/api/model-studio/overview/route.js (backend: MODEL_FACTORY, refactored — moved out of modelfactory/overview during the app/api restructuring)
src/app/api/model-studio/forecast/[...path]/route.js (backend: MODEL_STUDIO, bare host, unchanged — model list/pipelines/experiments — moved from p2/forecasting/[...path])

endpoints.name: getForecastOverview
endpoints.description: Returns KPI metrics for the ModelFactory forecasting service. Backend helper get_modelfactory_forecast_stats() supplies key-value pairs transformed into an array of metric_name/value objects.
endpoints.notes: CONFIRMED live 2026-07-09 (real payload pasted by the user) — this superseded the original intake table's sample, which was WRONG in two ways: (1) it showed `value` as a bare scalar (e.g. `12` or an ISO date string), but the real backend nests a full display object `{ name, counts, info }` inside `value` — `metric_name` is just a machine enum key, not the label; the label lives at `value.name`. Rendering `kpi.value` directly (as the first pass of ForecastOverview.jsx did, assuming a scalar) threw 'Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {name, counts, info})'. (2) the real `metric_name` enum values are `no_of_models` / `no_of_pipelines` / `no_of_experiments` — NOT `total_models` / `active_models` / `last_run_time` as the doc sample showed. ForecastOverview.jsx now destructures `kpi.value.{name,counts,info}` for display and keys its icon map (ICON_BY_METRIC) off the confirmed real `metric_name` values, with an index-based fallback for any future/unknown metric key.
